summary: The customer wants to explore an in situ spectroscopy pilot to monitor glucose and lactate in a cell culture process, replacing delayed lab measurements.

facts_stated.text: The cell culture process runs in an aqueous medium.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We run a cell culture process in an aqueous medium.

facts_stated.text: Glucose and lactate are measured from samples with a delay.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Glucose and lactate are measured from samples, and the delay makes it difficult to see changes promptly.

facts_stated.text: No probe or calibration strategy has been selected yet.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: we have not yet selected a probe or a calibration strategy.
